card.summary: The Strategic Subsea Cables Act of 2026 aims to improve United States Government coordination regarding the security, installation, maintenance, and repair of critical undersea infrastructure, including subsea telecommunications and energy infrastructure. The bill establishes an interagency committee, mandates reporting on foreign threats and past sabotage incidents, requires new personnel at the Department of State, and directs the imposition of sanctions on foreign persons responsible for or facilitating sabotage of critical undersea infrastructure.
